# SummerVestingWalletFactoryV2
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/contracts/SummerVestingWalletFactoryV2.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ISummerVestingWalletFactoryV2](../interfaces/i-summer-vesting-wallet-factory-v2.md), Ownable

**Title:**
SummerVestingWalletFactoryV2

Factory contract for creating new SummerVestingWalletV2 instances

Creates and tracks vesting wallets with configurable parameters


## State Variables
### token
STATE VARIABLES            ///

The ERC20 token that will be vested


```solidity
address public immutable token
```


### vestingWallets
Mapping from beneficiary address to their vesting wallet address


```solidity
mapping(address beneficiary => address vestingWallet) public vestingWallets
```


### vestingWalletOwners
Mapping from vesting wallet address to its beneficiary address


```solidity
mapping(address vestingWallet => address beneficiary) public vestingWalletOwners
```


## Functions
### constructor

CONSTRUCTOR               ///

Initializes the factory with the token to be vested


```solidity
constructor(address _token, address _owner) Ownable(_owner);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_token`|`address`|The address of the ERC20 token that will be vested|
|`_owner`|`address`|The initial owner of the factory (deployer, will transfer to multisig)|


### createVestingWallet

EXTERNAL FUNCTIONS           ///


```solidity
function createVestingWallet(
    address beneficiary,
    ISummerVestingWalletV2.VestingParams memory vestingParams,
    ISummerVestingWalletV2.PerformanceGoal[] memory performanceGoals
)
    external
    onlyOwner
    returns (address newVestingWallet);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`beneficiary`|`address`|Address of the beneficiary|
|`vestingParams`|`ISummerVestingWalletV2.VestingParams`|The vesting parameters|
|`performanceGoals`|`ISummerVestingWalletV2.PerformanceGoal[]`|Initial performance goals|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`newVestingWallet`|`address`|The address of the created vesting wallet|
